{{Money|1,700}} (Hard, Group Bonus) |shared_cash = 50% |music-1 = '''Version 1 Ambient''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator - Eggy Island Ambient -FULL VERSION-|center|250px|thumb]] |music-2 = '''Version 2 Ambient''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Easter Ambient|center|250px|thumb]] |music-3 = '''Final Wave ([[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]])''' [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Ducky D00M|center|250px|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Eggy Island''' was the event [[Maps|map]] for the [[Spring 2020 Event]]. Like other event maps, it had a specialized wave structure with special enemies. This map had two difficulties, hard and easy mode, which depended on the [[Elevators|elevator]] that the player chose to go into. Upon triumphing easy mode, players were rewarded with the {{RLinkC|4786878003|Tower of Eggs}} accessory, while triumphing hard mode resulted in the [[Swarmer]] being rewarded. Only {{Level|5+}} players could play hard mode. Players started with {{Money|1,800}} on easy mode ({{Money|1,900}} for players in the community group) and {{Money|1,600}} on hard mode ({{Money|1,700}} for players in the community group). On easy mode, you could not choose your own towers and were only supplied with the [[Scout]], [[Sniper]], [[Commander]], [[Pyromancer]] and [[Minigunner]] (tower skins, including {{Color|Platinum}} and {{Color|Golden}} skins, would still be applied). On hard mode, you would bring your current loadout. You could get up to {{Coins|180}} and {{Exp|25}} on easy mode, and {{Coins|270}} and {{Exp|37}} on hard mode on triumph. All modes had 100 base health, no matter how many people were in the match or their level. ==Design & Path== '''Eggy Island''' took place on a medieval village island, during spring. A large castle, with scattered wagons and huts, was indicative of this. There were various trees and grass mounds scattered across the map. You could place cliff towers on the grassy mounds. A wheatfield could be seen at the end of the map. A river with two waterfalls side-by-side each other at the end of the river could be seen. At the bottom of this waterfall, some sand and palm trees could be seen. Another waterfall could be seen upstream. Ducks could be seen in the river. Additionally, eggs could be spotted around the map. The beige cobblestone path began and ended at two caves. The path weaved around cottages and the castle, as well as crossing the river on two stone bridges. ==Story== The [[T.D.S. Organization]] sends their agents to '''Eggy Island''' to fight against [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]], who with their army of Easter-themed monsters has been terrorizing the area. ==Rewards== The game calculated how much {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Exp|}} and {{Tickets|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (08:00 UTC Friday – 08:00 UTC Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x. Any rewards that end in a decimal point were rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. Easy mode rewarded {{Tickets|10-25}} for every wave completed and hard mode rewarded {{Tickets|25-50}} for every wave completed. Rewards were calculated as: {| class="tds-table pad-10" style="text-align: center; margin:0 auto;" !Coins Reward !EXP Reward |- |{{Coins|18}} × Waves |Waves Completed × {{Exp|2.5}} |} ===Badges=== There were also a few [[badges]] which you could obtain when playing this map during the event, which may have additional rewards alongside the [[Badges|badge]]. These were: {{Badge |title = Obtained Tower of Eggs! |description = bruh you just killed a duck |rewards = {{RLinkC|4786878003|Tower of Eggs}} |image = OTEBadge.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Spring 2020 |description = Congrats on defeating Ducky D00M! |rewards = [[Swarmer]] |image = SpringBadge.png |obtainable = No }} {{Badge |title = Triumph Eggy Island |image = EIBadge.png |obtainable = No }} ==Waves Structure== Any wave bonus that ended in a decimal point was rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. In '''Eggy Island''', the formula for calculating wave bonus on each wave was: :({{Money|75}} - 7.5 × (Players - 1)) × Waves Completed The waves in '''Eggy Island''' also followed these timings: {| class="wikitable align-center" style="margin:0 auto; width:50%" !Waves !Wave Timer !Skip TimeHow long you have to wait before you can skip. |- |1-6 |1:30 |0:30Skip at 0:59. |- |7-8 |4:00 |1:20Skip at 2:39. |- |9-15 |166666666666666:40 |N/A |} '''Bolded''' names indicates an enemy type's debut. ----

==Strategy== ===Easy Mode=== *Initially, you want to have one person placing Level 0 [[Sniper]]s. **Afterwards, other people should be buying [[Minigunner]]s after the first wave. The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Commander]] can be very useful in providing support. *The optimum space to place towers is near the spawn of the map. **However, do not place towers close to the spawn as they will likely be stunned by the [[Eggsplosive]]. *If [[Ducky D00M (Eggy Island)|Ducky D00M]] leaves the first island, relocate your towers to the second island. ===Hard Mode=== *The [[Archer|Holiday Archer]] is recommended at the start as this map as there is a long straight, ideal for the tower. *Using lots of [[Minigunner]]s, [[Turret]]s and [[Ranger|Outlaws]] near the cottage that the path meanders around is recommended as this maximizes the range of towers. **The [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] and [[Militant|John]] are recommended for support. **The [[Medic]] is also recommended as its ability can cleanse stunned towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} EVBERo2U8AA9kQx.jpg|'''Eggy Island''' on the game thumbnail. 0e99bcd3f5e3fc028a6e49e2a130ecc5.jpg|'''Eggy Island''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} AgentsOfEgg.png|'''Eggy Island''' on a promotional image. EasterSaleNoArrow.png|'''Eggy Island''' on a promotional image. }} ==Trivia== *This was the first event map with multiple difficulties that gave different wave structures. **Since then, [[Huevous Hunt]] has released with the same system. *This was the first map (and event) that forced a set loadout onto players, but only on easy mode. *This was the first map to have a GFX icon. *The wheatfield near the end of the map was a direct representation of the second version of the Level 2 Default [[Farm]]. *This was the third event map to have a various difficulties, the first being [[The Heights]], and the second being [[Area 51]]. **The aforementioned maps did not change the health of the enemies, but gave a greater wave bonus for harder difficulties, ironically making it easier. ==Update History== *'''6 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0]] **'''Eggy Island''' added. *'''11 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.9|Release v1.9.0c]] **Ambient music replaced. *'''26 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.11|Release v1.11.0]] **'''Eggy Island''' removed. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}}
